title: rody's quiet place
description: This mod was made to support my friend who is doing the FNAF project Rody's Quiet Place
body:
Rody's Quiet Place

Rody's Quiet Place is an atmospheric horror mod for Minecraft that immerses the player in a world of secrets and frightening silence. Explore highly detailed locations filled with unique 3D decorations and hidden threats.

✈ Our official Telegram channel
--- ## 👁 About the project This mod is designed for those who appreciate a high-quality horror atmosphere. We have paid special attention to the visual aspect and sound design to make every step you take feel alive. The project is constantly evolving, and we are actively working on expanding its content and adding new gameplay mechanics. --- ## 👥 Project team | Role | Members | | :--- | :--- | | **3D Artists** | Markovi4900, MrYaroslav0703 | | **2D Artists** | Markovi4900, lemmlmyyy, Sidget | | **Animator** | MrYaroslav0703 | | **Sound and Music** | MrYaroslav0703, isho games | | **3D Modeler** | MrYaroslav0703 | --- ## 🛠 Installation instructions 1. Install **Minecraft Forge** version **1.20.1**. 2. **Required:** Download and install the **[GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)** library (animations and models will not work correctly without it). 3. Place the mod file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder. 4. Launch the game and be careful in the dark! ---
